name: get_physical_footprint
title: Physical Infrastructure Footprint
description: Physical-infrastructure footprint of one US-listed company: data-center build permits, power plant pipeline and regional grid load for the sites tied to the company, as publicly known on the as_of date. Counts (site_count, plant_count, event_count_365d) plus site and plant lists, newest first. capacity: permitted backup generator capacity in MW per site (an upper bound on onsite backup power, not IT load; lower_bound_sites counts sites where the figure is a floor because part of the permit is not yet itemised). trade_context: US imports of the goods tied to the company (by 6-digit HS code and country of origin), labelled sector_context_not_company: industry context, not the company's own revenue or purchases; about 11 tickers have no linked goods and return available=false. land_records: U.S. county land-use and building records (one county so far, starting 20 October 2026) for data-center land parcels held by the company's legal entities and the permitted data-center buildings on them (every original record field, permit number, issue date, floor area, build status, owner), plus planned data-center project areas within 300 m of its sites; each row is the version as first seen on or before as_of. Locations are as published; grid load is regional, not per site; fields not yet measured are null. Read-only evidence.
